items.name: core
items.title: Orlune core
items.description: Shared schemas, chart helpers, hooks, record types, exact-interval stats and the stylesheet. Every component needs this.
items.docs: Import the stylesheet once: import '@/components/orlune/styles.css'. It reads your shadcn theme variables when present.

items.name: sources-context
items.title: Sources context
items.description: SourcesProvider: your traces, flows and series by id, so a model can pick one to show without writing the data.

items.name: record-context
items.title: Record context
items.description: RecordProvider and hooks that hand a verifier result to the record components.

items.name: verify
items.title: Offline verifier
items.description: verifyRecord: checks the manifest hash, signatures, hash-chained ledger and deadline rules with Web Crypto. No network.

items.name: swimlane
items.title: Swimlane
items.description: Who does what, and where work waits.

items.name: trail
items.title: Trail
items.description: One request traced stop by stop, with total wait computed.

items.name: bottlenecks
items.title: Bottlenecks
items.description: Where work waits most, as ranked bars.

items.name: priority
items.title: Priority
items.description: Impact against effort grid: quick wins, big bets, fill-ins, park.

items.name: funnel
items.title: Funnel
items.description: How many make it through each step, with share kept computed.

items.name: compare
items.title: Compare
items.description: Today against a mapped version, row by row.

items.name: verify-status
items.title: Verify status
items.description: The verification verdict. Shows Not verified without a verifier result.

items.name: verify-badge
items.title: Verify badge
items.description: A small mark that says whether a record checked out and opens to the full result. It shows Verified only when the verdict and its own details agree.

items.name: ledger-timeline
items.title: Ledger timeline
items.description: The signed event ledger, with broken links and bad signatures flagged.

items.name: chain-graph
items.title: Chain graph
items.description: The ledger as linked hash blocks, showing exactly where a chain breaks.

items.name: guarantee-card
items.title: Guarantee card
items.description: One guarantee: statement, check, deadline, remedy and status.

items.name: retest-clock
items.title: Retest clock
items.description: A deadline against a clock: met, missed or time left, from the dates.

items.name: confidence-bar
items.title: Confidence bar
items.description: Observed pass rate with an exact interval and a cautious verdict.

items.name: approval-gate
items.title: Approval gate
items.description: A human approval step. Escalation counts as a correct outcome.

items.name: receipt-card
items.title: Receipt card
items.description: A printable signed receipt for one action.

items.name: json-tree
items.title: Json tree
items.description: A collapsible view of any JSON value: typed colours, copy a path, folds long strings, cuts circular references.

items.name: trace-explorer
items.title: Trace explorer
items.description: Flame graph, waterfall and span list on one axis, with minimap, zoom, search, critical path, a kind legend with share of time, and a detail panel.

items.name: diff-viewer
items.title: Diff viewer
items.description: Review-grade diff: file list, hunk headers, line numbers, folded context, changed words marked, split or unified, reviewer comments.

items.name: flow-canvas
items.title: Flow canvas
items.description: A pannable, zoomable flow diagram with swimlanes by owner, orthogonal edges, a minimap, controls and a step inspector.

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data grid
items.description: A virtualized grid: multi-sort, per-column filters, resize, pinned column, range select, CSV export, keyboard control.

items.name: control-chart
items.title: Control chart
items.description: A p-chart for a failure rate with per-point 3-sigma limits and the Western Electric run rules.

items.name: sankey
items.title: Sankey
items.description: Where cases go, sized by volume, with cases that vanished at a node called out.

items.name: approval-queue
items.title: Approval queue
items.description: A review queue where approval is bound to the exact plan by hash, edits make approvals stale, two approvers must differ, and undecided requests expire.

items.name: deadline-gantt
items.title: Deadline gantt
items.description: Every deadline clock on one axis: met, running, overdue and remedied, worked out from the dates.

items.name: activity-heatmap
items.title: Activity heatmap
items.description: A calendar of activity with breach days marked and the longest run without a breach computed.

items.name: eval-matrix
items.title: Eval matrix
items.description: Cases by runs with exact intervals and a paired McNemar comparison of any two runs.

items.name: fleet-board
items.title: Fleet board
items.description: Sortable, filterable board of deployments with the tightest deadline computed.

items.name: autonomy-gate
items.title: Autonomy gate
items.description: When an agent has earned more autonomy: agreement with a person, an exact interval widened for repeated looks, and your rule. It says eligible, never promoted.

items.name: evidence-table
items.title: Evidence table
items.description: Each extracted value with the places it was read from. Coverage and conflicts between sources are counted, and there is no confidence score.

items.name: plan-vs-actual
items.title: Plan vs actual
items.description: What the agent said it would do next to what it did: skipped, failed, blocked, out of order and unplanned steps, found by comparing the lists.

items.name: run-inspector
items.title: Run inspector
items.description: One agent run in four views, with the four questions people ask of a run answered first: did it finish, did it follow the plan, were the tool calls sound, is every value sourced.

items.name: approval-chain
items.title: Approval chain
items.description: Who has to approve, in order, and who is being waited on. Each step has a time limit, and a decision from the wrong person does not count and says why.

items.name: handoff-packet
items.title: Handoff packet
items.description: What an agent hands a person when it stops. The packet is checked: complete only when a person could act without asking the agent anything.

items.name: approval-workspace
items.title: Approval workspace
items.description: The approval queue with, for the request you are looking at, who has to approve, where each value came from and what the agent handed over.

items.name: drawing
items.title: Drawing and Ask
items.description: Draw one of your sources with the component built for it, and a question box that answers with a drawing. A model chooses which record to show and never writes its data.

items.name: catalog
items.title: Catalog and MCP App tool
items.description: What a model may place, as plain data, and a tool definition that points at a UI resource in the shape MCP Apps uses.

items.name: share-card
items.title: Share card
items.description: A 1200 by 630 SVG summary card made from plain data, for link previews and pasted summaries.

items.name: count
items.title: Count
items.description: Figures that ease to a new value when they change, and read their final value on first paint.

items.name: run-theatre
items.title: Run theatre
items.description: A run played back as a build: each step adds a layer, a loupe points at the value a step checked, a caption reads the step out word by word, and the time left counts down.

items.name: sealed-record
items.title: Sealed record
items.description: The end of a run as a seal: the figures count up to their final values and the record is marked sealed. Each figure is read out in its final value.

items.name: run-branches
items.title: Run branches
items.description: One run as a tree of saved states. Where it was replayed from an earlier step with something changed, it forks, and any two ends can be compared: where they split, what only each did, and which saved values differ.

items.name: run-variants
items.title: Run variants
items.description: Many runs grouped by the path they took, with how many followed the plan, what each path skipped, and how often it failed with an exact interval.

items.name: input-request
items.title: Input request
items.description: A form an agent hands to a person when it needs something it does not have. Every answer is checked against the field it was asked for, so the agent never receives a value of the wrong kind.

items.name: record-viewer
items.title: Record viewer
items.description: One record on one page: the verdict, each guarantee against what the verifier found, the signed events and the hash chain. It says verified only when the verdict and its own details agree.

items.name: adapters
items.title: Trace and message adapters
items.description: Read OpenTelemetry spans (OTLP JSON) into trace spans and AI SDK message parts into the steps PlanVsActual compares, so a trace you already collect can be shown without hand mapping.

items.name: autonomy-board
items.title: Autonomy board
items.description: Every agent in one list: its tier, whether it has earned a higher one, and what its grants and budget need. Each row is worked out from that agent's own cases, grants and budget.

items.name: permission-grant
items.title: Permission grant
items.description: What an agent is allowed to do, how much of each allowance is left and when it ends. Status comes from the grant, the clock and what has been used.

items.name: budget-meter
items.title: Budget meter
items.description: Spend against a limit for a period, with a marker for how much of the period has gone and a straight-line projection you can check by hand.

items.name: openui
items.title: OpenUI binding
items.description: Lets a model place the workflow components, the record views and the explorers through OpenUI Lang, without letting it set verification state or write the data the explorers show.

items.name: all
items.title: Everything
items.description: Every component, the verifier and the barrel file. The OpenUI binding is separate because it needs @openuidev/react-lang.
